title: Combined activity feed — all event types, reverse chronological
objective: Verify GET /assets/:uuid/activity returns a unified feed combining lifecycle, assignment, transfer, maintenance, stocktake, note, and status events, newest first, with actor/timestamp/type/summary.
preconditions: asset driven through: create → assign → note → maintenance open/close → return (from workflow suites).
test_data: asset uuid from end-to-end workflow chain
steps: Verify presence of each event type performed, ordering newest-first, and required fields per item.
expected_result: Feed contains all performed events exactly once, correctly ordered, each with type, actor, ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, and human summary; paginated if long.

title: Activity feed permission filtering
objective: Verify sensitive details (financial values, restricted fields) are hidden in feed items for roles without finance.view, and out-of-scope users get 404.
preconditions: asset with maintenance-cost event; operator (no finance.view) and auditor sessions; out-of-scope user.
steps: GET activity as operator → cost values absent/masked.
GET activity as auditor → cost visible.
expected_result: Field-level restrictions applied inside feed items; scope rules identical to detail endpoint; no leakage via summaries/details JSON.

title: Activity timeline UI on asset history tab
objective: Verify the history tab renders the combined feed as an accessible timeline with icons, relative+absolute timestamps, and empty state.
test_data: asset with rich history; brand-new asset
steps: Open history tab for rich asset; verify timeline entries match API feed.
Open history for new asset; verify empty state.
expected_result: Timeline matches API truth; icon+text per event type; accessible list semantics; empty state informative.
